flags.why: 'Ra vẻ' means to put on airs, not to stand on ceremony.
The example tells friends not to put on airs with each other, rather than not to stand on ceremony.
flags.fix: We're close friends; don't put on airs with each other.

flags.why: In ball sports, 'nhồi bóng' means to dribble by repeatedly bouncing the ball, not to juggle it.
flags.fix: to dribble (a ball by repeatedly bouncing it)

flags.why: Juggling a ball with one's feet is 'tâng bóng', whereas 'nhồi bóng' refers to bouncing it against the ground.
flags.fix: Cậu bé nhồi bóng rổ rất giỏi. = The boy is very good at dribbling a basketball.
